In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PHO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.15 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to one H and three O atoms to form distorted PHO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-45°. The P-H bond length is 1.41 Å. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to one H and three O atoms to form distorted PHO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-58°. The P-H bond length is 1.41 Å. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.60 Å. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-49°. The P-H bond length is 1.41 Å. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to one H and three O atoms to form distorted PHO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-44°. The P-H bond length is 1.41 Å. There are two shorter (1.51 Å) and one longer (1.62 Å) P-O bond length.
